rules.electric: name has ElecGtr or starts with GTR; not a DI, keys, vox, acoustic or bounce
rules.ambiguous_to_rest: GTR KEYS AMP (keys through an amp), Eggy's VOX GTR, Quicksand's Intro mics
rules.dropped: pre-recorded bounces (JMK 'Pre Record Tracks', Renesans 'GTR Pre Rec' and the other 'Pre Rec' bounces), Renesans' BAND CLICK, Eggy's master bounce: dropped from both mix and target (not listened to; Step 2 would listen before classing any)
rules.quicksand_intro: Quicksand's 32-35 Intro Close/Far files are 27.9 s long, silent across the stage-F context (it starts at 67.5 s), so their class has no effect
rules.not_in_declared_mix: sets 1-2 keep the catalogue's declared one-mic mix: other mics and files outside it (TF11, TF51, Ale Lak's Amp2, Eggy's master bounce) are excluded from mix and target; set-3 sessions have no declared mix, so every non-DI, non-dropped file counts (both mics of a guitar)
rules.doubles: a DT track is a double of the target when its guitar number matches the reference's, else of another guitar
